description: A bearded man in a short tunic and dark cloak, with a leather satchel slung across his chest, strides rapidly beside a dark bay horse on a cobbled street. A second man on the right holds another horse's reins. Torches burn on stone and timber buildings under a dusky sky, and the scene is painted in a warm, dark oil style. No visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
reason: The courier's tunic, cloak and sandals fit Rome, but the setting is a medieval or early-modern town: half-timbered buildings with a jettied upper storey, a stone arched doorway, and iron wall-bracket torches. The card is a Roman state relay in 27 BC, so the buildings need redrawing as a Roman way station with stone or brick architecture and no timber-frame or wall torches. The scene also shows the courier walking beside his horse rather than swinging down from a tired one at the station, so the action should be adjusted to match the card.
